description: The file defines an Android ListActivity demonstrating multiple selection mode with contextual actions, including handling item selection and menu interactions.

classes.name: List16
classes.description: An Android ListActivity demonstrating multi-choice selection mode with contextual action bar.

classes.name: ModeCallback
classes.description: Inner class implementing multi-choice mode listener to handle selection actions and update UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ListActivity, sets the choice mode to multiple modal, and populates the list with cheeses.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Sets a subtitle on the action bar instructing users to long press to start selection.

methods.name: onCreateActionMode
methods.description: Creates action mode, inflates menu, and sets the title for selection actions.

methods.name: onPrepareActionMode
methods.description: Prepares the action mode; returns true to indicate readiness.

methods.name: onActionItemClicked
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks during selection; can share selected items or show clicked item info.

methods.name: onDestroyActionMode
methods.description: Called when action mode is destroyed; no specific cleanup implemented.

methods.name: onItemCheckedStateChanged
methods.description: Updates the action mode subtitle based on the number of selected items.
